== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Outsider, also known as Ozriel, is a being from a distant world who exists beyond the borders of the current reality. Appearing as a human figure, he has been observed drifting in the void or appearing as a man dressed in black. He is described as an entity that watches from beyond the world's boundaries and is considered a threat to all existence. His ultimate goal involves the total [[destruction]] of the current world, which some describe as a prison-world, intending to destroy it along with its [[inhabitants]]. He has been known to engage in incomprehensible battles within the void against [[Great Elders]] like [[Urg’naut]]. While some view him as a potential source of salvation, others recognize that these beings are not allies and pose an existential danger to everyone.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Outsider is a destructive threat with the intention of blowing up the prison-world. He is an entity that others, such as [[Loreli]] and [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]], did not believe in until they were confronted by him.}}
